{"thought": "Good. BNDCL32rr has `{ 0 }` access array and takes 2 register operands: bndcl bnd, r32. When `printOperand` is called for the 2nd operand, op_count will be 1 and it'll read access[1] which is uninitialized (since get_op_access only sets access[0] = 0 for a `{ 0 }` input).

BNDCL encoding:
- In 32-bit mode: F3 0F 1A /r (with register operands)
- F3 0F 1A C0 = bndcl bnd0, eax
- ModRM C0 = mod=11 (register), reg=0 (bnd0), rm=0 (eax)

So my input should be: \x00\xf3\x0f\x1a\xc0

Let me verify this works with the disassembler. But first let me look at what platform 0 maps to in the fuzzer."}
function.name: think
